blocks.text: The GTBA-ONEKLIK 4th Travel Sale Expo (TSE) concluded a spectacular three-day run October 2–4, 2026, at the Megatrade Hall, SM Megamall, drawing 56,000 attendees across 200 booths and posting its highest sales performance since 2023. Global Tourism Business Association (GTBA) Founder and President Michelle Taylan joins international ambassadors, diplomats, and event organizers on stage following the ribbon-cutting ceremony of the Travel Sale Expo. The annual event brings together key industry leaders, foreign envoys, and travel stakeholders to promote cross-border tourism, economic cooperation, and international ties. Under the inspiring theme “Where Travel Dreams Come Alive,” this year’s edition delivered far more than […]...
